summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp., a British Columbia-incorporated, Nasdaq-listed (HYFT) Bio-Native AI company, furnished a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) attaching a press release dated October 14, 2026, announcing three senior R&D hires in its Boston development leadership: Zachary Maben (Director, Antigen Discovery Protein Engineering; ex-Arbor, Pfizer), Joanne Lim (Director, Preclinical Development; ex-Orum, Codiak, Novartis), and Shuji Sato (VP, Innovative Solutions, expanded pipeline duties). The release is a routine personnel/operations update tied to advancing its pipeline toward preclinical efficacy studies; no transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. No special-situation event; monitor only pipeline or partnering developments.
